test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Correct the spelling of the underlined word.

While driving his car, he applied __breaks__ in time to save himself and his family from an accident.
solution:
The correct answer is "**brakes.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the word "breaks" is used incorrectly.
 
• The word "breaks" means a place in the surface of something where it has cracked from damage. 
 
 
• Example: Her words break my heart.
 
 
 
• **The correct word to use in place of "breaks" is the word 'brakes' which refers to the mechanism used to slow down or stop a vehicle.**
 
 
• Example: The brakes of the vehicle failed at that time.
 
 

Hence,** the correct answer is option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The incorrect options are:
 
• Option 1 **(brave)** means showing courage or fearlessness. Example: She was brave enough to face her fears.
 
• Option 3 **(bricks)** are rectangular blocks used for building walls or other structures. Example: The house was made of red bricks.
 
• Option 4 **(braces) **are orthodontic devices used to align teeth. Example: She had to wear braces for a year.
